notes:
Funding Radar helps a founder explain an investor shortlist before sending the first email. Start with product, stage and country, then follow comparable funding rounds to the firms and people behind them.

Three original TinySet investigations cover US developer tools, UK energy software and India payments. They retain thirty provider rows. Dated reviews correct or withhold claims, while six labelled public-web additions bring reviewed recent-company coverage to ten per case. Those additions are not TinySet output.

AlleyCorp, Pi Labs, Realyze and Arkam have selected, explained records with investment proof, a named responsible deal person, scoped cheque/stage policy and a founder route. Historical role changes, firm-versus-round leadership and fit differences stay visible. Volve remains conditional.

A new security-compliance brief completed a genuine run: nineteen returned rows, sixteen raw recent claims and seventeen companies supported by later human review, with no manual additions. SignalFire stays conditional because AI-native eligibility and current programme intake are unconfirmed. No investor is approach-ready for that input. Generic dispatch is real; verification and investor enrichment remain human-reviewed.

Inspect sources, filter results and export JSON/CSV. The 100-second captioned demo shows the real workflow. An anonymous public clone passed 131 tests, TypeScript/build/formatting and all 84 source hashes. Desktop-browser and actual-download checks passed too. Live research defaults off.
